scope.title: Freelance bookkeepers and bank-feed reconciliation
scope.domain: Find a product that freelance bookkeepers would pay for, around reconciling client bank feeds. Explore bank-feed matching errors, client document chasing, month-end close, multi-client switching and categorization rules. Identify observed pain, paid substitutes or switching behavior, and the smallest sellable workflow.
scope.observations: Major accounting platforms already include bank-feed matching rules. Look for bookkeepers' own accounts of where current workflows still fail; do not treat product claims as evidence of customer pain.
scope.riskEvaluationCriteria: Pain must be observed firsthand by bookkeepers. Prefer paid substitutes or switching evidence and a small sellable workflow over replacing an accounting platform. Clarify whether the opportunity serves solo freelancers or firms with 2-10 staff.
